Claim-level anchor set to decisions-log.md since the document's own text singles that file out as the source of record for the specific parameters it flags as non-registered; the 95% value is a per-value read override with anchor.path null (whole-document, no separate file). 'Decision 10' and 'decisions-log.md:337' (a line-number citation) excluded from values per rule 5.
